thread:
maria: Quick flagthe /v1/generate API ref has an example that shows \"status\": \"queued\" together with a populated \"result\". That's inconsistent with prod behavior where queued responses are 202 and `result` is null. Posting a draft PR to fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834

sam: Oof, that's confusing. Which file?

maria: docs/reference/generate.md. Support is getting tickets where users try to read result immediately and crash.

jess: I saw failing doc-driven tests in CI earlier; probably related.

sam: Plan: update OpenAPI examples to show two flows: 202 queued (result = null) and 200 sync (result present). Also mark `result` nullable in the schema and add a ?wait_for_completion example.

nnamdi: Add a short migration note for any customers parsing response.result directly. Support needs that for KB.

jess: I'll change snippets to check response.status before accessing result. Proposed snippet for JS/Python in the docs.

support: We're drafting KB now. Please include the client pattern and link to KB in the PR.

maria: I'll keep this PR narrowly scoped to the example/schema change. Param-name cleanup (`max_new_tokens` vs `max_tokens`) becomes a follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/427

sam: I'll update openapi.yaml, add 202 example, and regenerate the static examples. Also will add a unit test for example-driven docs.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-834--docs.redwood.ai (build succeeded) :white_check_mark:

nnamdi: After merge, ping SDK leads so they can ship a compatibility patch.
\jmaria: tiny typo: I meant to tag @jess earlier.

jess: Reviewing now. I prefer the Python snippet to explicitly poll instead of relying on exceptions.

maria: Thanks, will merge after approvals and coordinate with platform to sync the OpenAPI spec in the infra repo.

support: We'll notify customers once merged and include the changelog line: \"Clarified /v1/generate examples: queued (202) vs immediate (200).\"

maria: Great teamwork, landing this today.
